hero.title: Turn patient intake conversations into
hero.subtitle: Nabd conducts empathetic, conversational pre-visit interviews with patients and delivers structured, SOAP-aligned clinical briefs directly to doctors before consultation begins.

preview.patientMessage: I've had this tight burning feeling in the center of my chest since yesterday evening, especially when walking up stairs.
preview.nabdResponse: Thank you for sharing, Omar. Does this sensation radiate to your left arm, jaw, or shoulder, and have you noticed any shortness of breath?
preview.patientReply: A little bit to my left shoulder. Breathing feels a bit heavier than usual.
preview.triageAlert: Triage Alert: Potential angina — prioritize 12-lead ECG on arrival
preview.subjectiveBody: 42-year-old male presents with acute onset retrosternal chest discomfort radiating to left shoulder, exacerbated by exertion.
preview.objectiveBody: Positive for exertional dyspnea. Negative for syncope, diaphoresis, or palpitations.

features.title: Engineered for high-throughput clinical workflows
features.subtitle: Designed alongside healthcare providers to reduce administrative burden and eliminate diagnostic friction.

intake.title: Conversational Intake
intake.description: Patients chat naturally in English or Arabic via mobile web or SMS. Nabd dynamically asks clarifying follow-ups tailored to symptoms without intimidating medical jargon.

summaries.title: Clinician-Ready Briefs
summaries.description: Generates clean Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan notes, red-flagging critical triage alerts before the doctor enters the examination room.

security.title: Clinical Privacy & Compliance
security.description: Encrypted in transit and at rest. Strict zero-retention option for model training, aligning with international patient privacy standards and local healthcare regulations.

howItWorks.title: Seamless integration from waiting room to exam room
howItWorks.subtitle: No documentation friction or delays. Three steps that transform the traditional clinical encounter.

step1.title: Patient Chat Before the Visit
step1.description: Patients receive a secure link via SMS or QR code in the waiting lounge. Nabd conducts an empathetic, multi-turn clinical dialogue in their preferred language.

step2.title: Real-Time AI Medical Reasoning
step2.description: Our medical reasoning engine analyzes the dialogue, identifies chief complaints, chronologies, medications, and relevant family histories with clinical precision.

step3.title: 60-Second Physician Review
step3.description: The physician reviews a synthesized 60-second summary before greeting the patient, saving valuable documentation minutes and improving bedside connection.
